args: if [ -n "$KLAYOUT_MCP_URL" ]; then mcp_url="$KLAYOUT_MCP_URL"; else config_path="$KLAYOUT_MCP_CONFIG"; if [ -z "$config_path" ]; then config_path="$HOME/.klayout/klayoutclaw.json"; fi; if [ -f "$config_path" ]; then mcp_url="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; c=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8")); c=c.get("mcp", c); tls=c.get("tls", False); port=int(c.get("port", 8765)); endpoint=c.get("endpoint", "/mcp"); host=c.get("bind", "127.0.0.1"); host="127.0.0.1" if host in ("0.0.0.0", "::", "*") else host; host="["+host+"]" if ":" in host and not host.startswith("[") else host; print(("https" if tls else "http")+"://"+host+":"+str(port)+endpoint)' "$config_path")" || exit 1; else mcp_url="$1"; fi; fi; exec npx -y mcp-remote "$mcp_url" --allow-http
